name: Mascot maker
summary: The club builds its mascot one part each: a drawn critter with callout tags for critter, color, eyes, headgear and what it's holding, each showing who picked it; tap an open tag, flip through drawn options with a live preview, lock it in and it pops on, and the finished mascot hops and gets its name.
useWhen: we need a mascot for the club
what should our club's sticker character look like
let's make a mascot for the comp banner
everyone pick one thing for the mascot
dontUseWhen: voting on a club logo from finished options (use a poll)
a pixel sprite of yourself (use sprite-maker)
a group quilt of squares (use group-quilt)

name.description: The mascot's name once finished, e.g. 'Crimpy'

option.description: animal: Goat, Frog, Bear, Blob; color: Green, Orange, Purple, Blue; eyes: Dots, Googly, Sleepy, Starry; head: Helmet, Beanie, Headlamp, Nothing; hold: Chalk bag, Rope, Rice cooker, Flag

said.description: What they said, in their words
